gen-gf-paprika-gf-recursive: Paprika swaggers in with wide-spaced letters and lowercase that fills the line. Recursive sits beneath it with a tall midline and a single unshaded stroke that never swells, which is where the pair gets its tension.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-roboto-condensed: Expressive Paprika lets its letters spread wide and its lowercase stand like capitals. Roboto Condensed runs underneath with barely visible gaps inside each word and a large lowercase, so a long page glides past the eye like wire.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads like magnified text, its weight unvarying from one word to the next, as flat as fineliner ink. Paprika, meanwhile, does the loud, spread-out work.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-secular-one: Secular One reads with a dominant midsection that swallows the line's height, and no modulation at all. Secular One keeps that single tube-wide track going over many lines, while Paprika above it spreads out and shouts.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-smooch-sans: Scattered, wide-set letters and lowercase that fills the line like capitals mark Paprika out at once. Smooch Sans tucks in below with a high midline, an s with generous bends, and a line packed so tight the gaps almost vanish.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Loud up top, plain below. Sofia Sans Condensed is a plain sans with a big x-height, curves that leave loops unfinished, and no hairlines anywhere, so it reads smoothly across a long stretch.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-spline-sans-mono: Paprika spreads out loudly, while Spline Sans Mono answers in bold, fixed-width, code-style letters of flat weight and near-capital lowercase. Paprika earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-tiny5: Approachable Tiny5 keeps its tall body so compact that the ascenders look short, and it sits quietly under Paprika's wide-spaced swagger. A longer read stays tidy.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-truculenta: Truculenta is a plain sans with short ascenders, a tall x-height, and rounded forms crowded into a compact line yet open to the side. Paprika, by contrast, spreads its letters wide and shouts, and Truculenta handles the smooth, pen-plotter reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu reads with a lofty lowercase band that gives each line a tall, modern look. And over a long page that lofty band keeps the text easy to follow, a quiet foil to Paprika's wide-spaced display letters.
